item.title: About Us
item.description:
🏡 About Sapumal Lodge

We are the Dissanayake family, proud owners of Sapumal Lodge — a small, family-run hotel built with care, run with love, and maintained with pride.

Sapumal Lodge is not just a business, it’s the house we grew up in. Every wall, every room holds memories, and we’ve transformed this beloved family home into a peaceful haven for guests from all over the world.

We are passionate about providing a friendly, family-oriented service. Whether you’re visiting Anuradhapura for its sacred history or a quiet getaway, we want you to feel truly at home.

item.title: Breakfast
item.description:
🥣 Breakfast at Sapumal Lodge

Start your day with a wholesome, homemade breakfast lovingly prepared using fresh, local ingredients. Whether you’re heading out for a day of exploring ancient Anuradhapura or just relaxing at the lodge, our breakfast is sure to energize you.

🍽️ What We Offer

  • 🥪 Freshly toasted bread and spreads
  • 🍳 Boiled eggs and omelettes
  • 🥞 Pancakes and Sri Lankan-style roti
  • 🧀 Butter, jam, and kiri pani (curd and treacle)
  • 🫕 Dhal curry, coconut sambol, and local condiments
  • 🍉 A colourful platter of seasonal tropical fruits
  • 🧃 Freshly made fruit juice (watermelon, papaya, or orange)
  • ☕ Ceylon tea or Nescafé

Vegetarian and child-friendly options are always available.

item.title: E-bike Rental
item.description:
⚡ Discover Anuradhapura the Easy Way — by E-Bike!

Explore the sacred city of Anuradhapura with comfort, freedom, and zero emissions.
With our smooth, quiet electric bikes, you can effortlessly reach ancient ruins, lakes, temples, and hidden gems. All at your own pace!

🚲 Why Choose Our E-Bikes?

  • 🔋 Effortless Travel – Go farther with less effort using pedal-assist electric motors
  • 🌱 Eco-Friendly – No fuel. No fumes. Just you and nature
  • 🛣️ Freedom to Explore – Stop, detour, and wander. No traffic or timetables
  • 💸 Cost Effective – Budget-friendly and fuel-free
  • 🛡️ Safe & Reliable – Well-maintained e-bikes with lock, lights, and backup support

💰 Special Price for Our Guests

If you’re staying at Sapumal Lodge, you can rent an e-bike for just
🪙 USD $5 per day!

item.title: Free Bicycles
item.description:
🚲 Explore Anuradhapura on Two Wheels — For Free!

As part of our commitment to sustainability and guest satisfaction, Sapumal Lodge offers free bicycle rentals to all our guests! This is one of our most-loved Go Green initiatives. It’s a perfect way to explore the sacred city at your own pace.

Whether you’re heading to the ancient ruins, nearby lakes, or just out for a relaxing ride, our well-maintained bikes provide a peaceful and healthy way to experience Anuradhapura.

item.title: Wilpattu Safari
item.description:
🐆 Wilpattu Private Safari

Wilpattu National Park is Sri Lanka’s largest wildlife reserve, renowned for its natural lakes (villus) and incredible biodiversity — including leopards, elephants, and sloth bears.

Just a short drive from Anuradhapura, Wilpattu offers peaceful, scenic safaris through forests and open plains, making it the perfect destination for nature lovers and wildlife photographers.

🛻 What’s Included

  • ✅ Private safari jeep (max comfort, photography-friendly)
  • ✅ Experienced guide/tracker
  • ✅ Entry tickets to Wilpattu National Park
  • ✅ Pickup & drop-off (Anuradhapura and Wilpattu area)
  • ✅ Breakfast pack
  • ✅ Picnic lunch inside the park (vegetarian & local options available)
  • ✅ Drinking water, juice, and snacks
  • ✅ Photo stops and rest breaks

💰 Safari Rates

💵 Prices are per person and include everything listed above.
